packages.name: core
packages.blurb: Specs, dimensions, intervals, expressions — the vocabulary everything else is written in.

symbols.name: AcceptanceRegion
symbols.signature: (n: int, p: float, alpha: float, lower: int, upper: int)
symbols.summary: An exact binomial acceptance region for a rate criterion.

symbols.name: Add
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['add'] = 'add', terms: tuple[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, ...])
symbols.summary: Sum of terms sharing one dimension.
symbols.usage: response = Equation(lhs=y, rhs=Add(terms=(Param(name="a", dimension=D.outcome), hill)), name="response")

symbols.name: Apply
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['apply'] = 'apply', fn: Literal['exp', 'log', 'log1p', 'expm1', 'tanh', 'sigmoid', 'logit', 'softplus', 'neg', 'relu', 'step', 'sin', 'cos'], arg: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque)
symbols.summary: A scalar function of one argument. Argument and result are dimensionless.

symbols.name: ApplyFn
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)

symbols.name: Assumption
symbols.signature: (name: str, facet: str, statement: str, challenged_by: str = '', state: Literal['unverified', 'satisfied', 'violated', 'asserted'] = 'unverified', detail: dict[str, str] = {})
symbols.summary: A named, falsifiable condition that licenses a step.
symbols.usage:
overlap = Assumption(
    name="overlap",
    facet="population",
    statement="every target stratum has positive support in the source",
    challenged_by="propensity / dose overlap diagnostic",
)

symbols.name: BASES
symbols.summary: The declarable set of base dimensions.

symbols.name: BaseRegistry
symbols.signature: (defaults: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = ...) -> None
symbols.summary: The declarable set of base dimensions.

symbols.name: Blocked
symbols.signature: (reason: str, detail: dict[str, str] = {}, status: Literal['blocked'] = 'blocked')
symbols.summary: The request is not licensed: no route, no transfer, no identification.

symbols.name: Capability
symbols.signature: (*values)
symbols.summary: What a producer can do. A request needing an absent one degrades, typed.

symbols.name: Const
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['const'] = 'const', value: float | tuple[float, ...], dimension: Dimension)
symbols.summary: A literal with a declared dimension: a scalar, or a short vector (a lag index, knots).

symbols.name: Constraint
symbols.signature: (name: str, expr: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, family: Literal['normal', 'lognormal'], observed: float, scale: float, detail: dict[str, str] = {})
symbols.summary: A soft constraint on a scalar function of the parameters: ``observed ~ p(expr(θ), scale)``.
symbols.usage:
lift = Constraint(
    name="mean_lift@experiment_1",
    expr=Reduce(op="mean", arg=hill),
    family="normal",
    observed=6.0,
    scale=0.5,
    detail={"measurement": "experiment_1", "doses": "observed"},
)

symbols.name: Convolve
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['convolve'] = 'convolve', signal: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, kernel: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque)
symbols.summary: Causal convolution of ``signal`` with ``kernel`` along the time axis.

symbols.name: Covariate
symbols.signature: (name: str, dimension: Dimension | None = None, unit: str | None = None, description: str = '')
symbols.summary: Measured, not intervened on.

symbols.name: D
symbols.summary: The declarable set of base dimensions.

symbols.name: DIGITS
symbols.summary: int([x]) -> integer int(x, base=10) -> integer
symbols.usage: print("digits kept of the uncertainty:", DIGITS)

symbols.name: Data
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['data'] = 'data', name: str, dimension: Dimension)
symbols.summary: A column of the panel. Its dimension is the one its role declares.

symbols.name: DesignMatrix
symbols.signature: (X: NDArray[float64], columns: tuple[str, ...], offset: NDArray[float64], at: Mapping[str, NDArray[float64]]) -> None
symbols.summary: ``mu = offset + X @ theta[columns]`` at a fixed point of the nonlinear parameters.
symbols.usage: dm = DesignMatrix(X=X, columns=("a", "b"), offset=np.zeros(4), at={"k": np.array(50.0)})

symbols.name: Dimension
symbols.signature: (exponents: dict[str, Fraction])
symbols.summary: A product of declared base dimensions raised to rational exponents.

symbols.name: DimensionError
symbols.summary: Two quantities of different dimension were combined.

symbols.name: Div
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['div'] = 'div', numerator: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, denominator: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque)
symbols.summary: Quotient; exponents subtract.

symbols.name: Dose
symbols.signature: (name: str, dimension: Dimension | None = None, unit: str | None = None, description: str = '', numeraire: str | None = None)
symbols.summary: The magnitude of an intervention on a treatment, with units and a numeraire.

symbols.name: Entity
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: What every entity spec provides: a name, an optional dimension and unit.

symbols.name: EntityName
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: Runtime representation of an annotated type.

symbols.name: Equation
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['equation'] = 'equation', lhs: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, rhs: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, name: str = '')
symbols.summary: ``lhs = rhs``; both sides must share a dimension.
symbols.usage: response = Equation(lhs=y, rhs=Add(terms=(Param(name="a", dimension=D.outcome), hill)), name="response")

symbols.name: Expr
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: Runtime representation of an annotated type.
symbols.usage:
hill: Expr = Mul(factors=(beta, Div(numerator=Pow(base=x, exponent=s),
                                    denominator=Add(terms=(one, Pow(base=x, exponent=s))))))

symbols.name: Failure
symbols.summary: Represent a PEP 604 union type

symbols.name: Gather
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['gather'] = 'gather', source: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, index: Data)
symbols.summary: ``source[..., index]``: pick entries of a vector-valued expression by an integer column.

symbols.name: Interval
symbols.signature: (lower: float, upper: float, definition: Literal['eti', 'hdi', 'wald'], mass: float)
symbols.summary: ``[lower, upper]`` with the definition and the mass it was computed at.

symbols.name: Intervention
symbols.signature: (doses: dict[str, float], mode: Literal['set', 'scale', 'shift'] = 'set', version: str = 'unspecified', window: TimeWindow | None = None)
symbols.summary: What is set, to what value, how, over what support.

symbols.name: LedgerLine
symbols.signature: (kind: str, statement: str, assumption: Assumption | None = None, detail: dict[str, str] = {}, source: str = '', target: str = '')
symbols.summary: One entry in the assumption ledger.
symbols.usage:
line = LedgerLine(
    kind="facet:population",
    statement="transferred from region=north to region=all under overlap",
    assumption=overlap.asserted(),
    detail={"from": "north", "to": "all"},
)

symbols.name: Likelihood
symbols.signature: (family: Literal['normal', 'lognormal', 'student_t', 'poisson'], scale: str | None = None, scale_expr: Optional[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque] = None, df: float | None = None)
symbols.summary: How the outcome column is distributed around the mean expression.

symbols.name: LikelihoodFamily
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)

symbols.name: Link
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['link'] = 'link', fn: Literal['identity', 'log', 'logit'], arg: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque)
symbols.summary: A GLM link applied to a dimensionless argument (after a reference divide).

symbols.name: LinkFn
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)

symbols.name: Model
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.usage:
bad_trees: list[Model] = [
    Apply(fn="log", arg=dose),
    Add(terms=(beta, Mul(factors=(beta, Apply(fn="log", arg=dose))))),
    Pow(base=dose, exponent=s),
    Convolve(signal=dose, kernel=k),
]

symbols.name: ModelSpec
symbols.signature: (name: str, mean: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, outcome: Data, likelihood: Likelihood, parameters: tuple[Param, ...], constraints: tuple[Constraint, ...] = ())
symbols.summary: Mean expression + outcome column + likelihood + every parameter's prior.
symbols.usage:
model = ModelSpec(
    name="panel_hill",
    mean=mean,
    outcome=y,
    likelihood=Likelihood(family=family, scale="sigma"),
    parameters=(k, s, beta, lam, a_mean, a_sd, alpha, sigma),
)

symbols.name: Mul
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['mul'] = 'mul', factors: tuple[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, ...])
symbols.summary: Product; exponents add.

symbols.name: NonEmptyStr
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: Runtime representation of an annotated type.
symbols.usage: reason: NonEmptyStr = "a reason that is not blank"

symbols.name: ODESystem
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['ode'] = 'ode', states: tuple[Data, ...], rhs: tuple[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, ...], time: Data)
symbols.summary: ``d(state_i)/dt = rhs_i`` for each state. Dimension-check-only in 1.0 (C1).

symbols.name: Opaque
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['opaque'] = 'opaque', name: str, inputs: tuple[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, ...] = (), dimension: Dimension)
symbols.summary: A user-supplied function the tree cannot express.

symbols.name: OpaqueFn
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.usage: geometric: OpaqueFn = lambda lam, L=6: lam ** np.arange(L)

symbols.name: OpaqueRegistry
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: A Mapping is a generic container for associating key/value pairs.

symbols.name: Outcome
symbols.signature: (name: str, dimension: Dimension | None = None, unit: str | None = None, description: str = '', aggregation: Literal['sum', 'mean', 'rate'] = 'sum')
symbols.summary: What you are trying to move.

symbols.name: PRIOR_HYPER
symbols.summary: dict() -> new empty dictionary dict(mapping) -> new dictionary initialized from a mapping object's (key, value) pairs dict(iterable) -> new dictionary initialized as if via: d = {} for k, v in iterable: d[k] = v dict(**kwargs) -> new dictionary initialized with the name=value pairs in the keyword argument list.  For example:  dict(one=1, two=2)

symbols.name: Param
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['param'] = 'param', name: str, dimension: Dimension, prior: Prior | None = None, shape: tuple[int, ...] = ())
symbols.summary: A parameter to be inferred, with a declared dimension and an optional prior.

symbols.name: Population
symbols.signature: (name: str, description: str = '', strata: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {})
symbols.summary: A target population: a name and, where known, the strata weights that define it.

symbols.name: Posterior
symbols.signature: (draws: Mapping[str, ArrayLike], *, coords: Mapping[str, Sequence[Any]] | None = None, provenance: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None
symbols.summary: Draws keyed by name, each ``(chain, draw, *shape)``, plus coords and provenance.

symbols.name: Pow
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['pow'] = 'pow', base: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, exponent: Union[Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, Fraction])
symbols.summary: ``base ** exponent``.

symbols.name: PredictiveDraws
symbols.signature: (values: NDArray[float64], intervention: Intervention, window: TimeWindow | None = None, coords: Mapping[str, Sequence[Any]] = <factory>, seed: int | None = None) -> None
symbols.summary: Outcome draws under an intervention: ``values`` is ``(chain, draw, *shape)``.
symbols.usage: return PredictiveDraws(values=beta @ dose, intervention=iv, window=window, seed=seed)

symbols.name: Prior
symbols.signature: (family: Literal['normal', 'halfnormal', 'lognormal', 'beta', 'gamma', 'uniform', 'fixed'], hyper: dict[str, float | str])
symbols.summary: A named prior family with hyperparameters.

symbols.name: PriorFamily
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)

symbols.name: Reduce
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['reduce'] = 'reduce', op: Literal['sum', 'mean', 'max'], arg: Const | Data | Param | Add | Mul | Div | Pow | Apply | Convolve | Reduce | Gather | Link | Opaque, keepdims: bool = False)
symbols.summary: Reduce ``arg`` along its last axis: ``sum``, ``mean``, ``max``. Dimension is preserved.

symbols.name: SchemaVersionError
symbols.signature: (spec: str, found: str, expected: str) -> None
symbols.summary: A serialized spec's version has no migration to the current class version.

symbols.name: Spec
symbols.summary: Frozen, versioned, hashable configuration object. Subclass freely.

symbols.name: SpecDiff
symbols.signature: (spec: str, changed: dict[str, tuple[Any, Any]])
symbols.summary: Field-level differences between two specs of the same type.

symbols.name: SpecError
symbols.summary: Base class for spec construction and (de)serialization failures.

symbols.name: Summary
symbols.signature: (mean: float, median: float, sd: float, interval: Interval, n: int)
symbols.summary: Point summaries of a set of draws plus one provenance-carrying interval.

symbols.name: SupportsEstimands
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: A fitted producer: posterior draws + counterfactual predictions + declared estimands.
symbols.usage: print([m for m in dir(SupportsEstimands) if not m.startswith("_")])

symbols.name: SupportsForward
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: A deterministic response surface: ``forward`` == ``interpret.value(expr)``.

symbols.name: SupportsIntervention
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: Anything you can ask a counterfactual of.

symbols.name: SupportsPosterior
symbols.signature: (*args, **kwargs)
symbols.summary: Anything with draws you can ask questions of.

symbols.name: System
symbols.signature: (node: Literal['system'] = 'system', equations: tuple[Equation, ...])
symbols.summary: A set of equations, each checked independently.

symbols.name: TimeWindow
symbols.signature: (start: int, stop: int, basis: Literal['per_period', 'cumulative'] = 'cumulative')
symbols.summary: A half-open index window ``[start, stop)`` on the panel's time axis, with a basis.

symbols.name: Treatment
symbols.signature: (name: str, dimension: Dimension | None = None, unit: str | None = None, description: str = '')
symbols.summary: The thing you can intervene on. Its dimension is the dose's dimension.
symbols.usage:
design = ProbeDesign(
    treatment=Treatment(name="fertilizer", dimension=D.currency, unit="USD"),
    levels=(0.0, 50.0, 100.0),
    window=TimeWindow(start=0, stop=8),
)

symbols.name: UNITS
symbols.summary: Units of measure, each attached to a base dimension, with conversions.

symbols.name: UndeclaredBaseError
symbols.summary: A dimension named a base that the registry has not declared.

symbols.name: UndimensionedWarning
symbols.summary: An entity was declared without a dimension and is treated as dimensionless (D6).
symbols.usage: print(loose.dim, "|", [w.category.__name__ for w in caught], "|", issubclass(caught[0].category, UndimensionedWarning))

symbols.name: Unit
symbols.signature: (name: str, dimension: Dimension | None = None, unit: str | None = None, description: str = '', kind: Literal['individual', 'cluster', 'aggregate'] = 'individual')
symbols.summary: The randomization / observation unit: a plot, a patient, a region.

symbols.name: UnitConversionError
symbols.summary: No conversion is registered between two units of the same dimension.

symbols.name: UnitSystem
symbols.signature: () -> None
symbols.summary: Units of measure, each attached to a base dimension, with conversions.

symbols.name: UnknownSpecError
symbols.summary: The envelope names a class that cannot be imported or is not a Spec.

symbols.name: Unsupported
symbols.signature: (reason: str, detail: dict[str, str] = {}, missing: tuple[str, ...] = (), status: Literal['unsupported'] = 'unsupported')
symbols.summary: The producer lacks a capability the request needs.

symbols.name: Unverified
symbols.signature: (reason: str, detail: dict[str, str] = {}, status: Literal['unverified'] = 'unverified')
symbols.summary: An assumption the machinery cannot check; the caller decides.
symbols.usage: print(bool(Unsupported(reason="no marginal capability", missing=("marginal",))), bool(Unverified(reason="overlap not checked")))

symbols.name: Verdict
symbols.signature: (status: Literal['identified', 'downgraded', 'blocked', 'unsupported', 'unverified'], reason: str = '', assumptions: tuple[Assumption, ...] = (), route: str = '')
symbols.summary: An honest answer about whether a quantity is licensed, and under what.

symbols.name: causal_convolve
symbols.signature: (signal: Array, weights: Array) -> Array
symbols.summary: ``y[..., t] = Σ_l w[..., l] · x[..., t-l]`` with zero history before ``t=0``.

symbols.name: check
symbols.signature: (model: Model, expected: Dimension | None = None) -> Dimension
symbols.summary: ``dimension`` plus an optional assertion against a declared dimension.

symbols.name: children
symbols.signature: (node: Model) -> tuple[Model, ...]
symbols.summary: Direct sub-nodes, in a stable order.

symbols.name: clopper_pearson
symbols.signature: (n: int, p: float, alpha: float = 0.001) -> AcceptanceRegion
symbols.summary: Exact two-sided binomial acceptance region for ``k ~ Binomial(n, p)``.

symbols.name: compile_jax
symbols.signature: (model: Model, *, opaque: JaxOpaqueRegistry | None = None) -> JaxFn
symbols.summary: Build a traceable ``f(data, params)`` for ``model``.

symbols.name: compile_log_density
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, *, opaque: JaxOpaqueRegistry | None = None) -> Callable[[Mapping[str, Any], Mapping[str, Any]], Any]
symbols.summary: ``f(data, z) -> log posterior`` in unconstrained coordinates, traceable by jax.

symbols.name: constrain
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, z: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> tuple[dict[str, Array], float]
symbols.summary: Inverse of ``unconstrain``; also returns the summed log-Jacobian ``log|dθ/dz|``.

symbols.name: data_names
symbols.signature: (node: Model) -> tuple[str, ...]
symbols.summary: Every distinct ``Data`` name in the tree, by first appearance.
symbols.usage: print([p.name for p in params(model)], data_names(model))

symbols.name: decimals_for
symbols.signature: (uncertainty: float, *, digits: int = 2) -> int
symbols.summary: Decimal places warranted by ``uncertainty``, for ``round`` and ``format``.

symbols.name: dimension
symbols.signature: (model: Model, path: str = '') -> Dimension
symbols.summary: The dimension of ``model``; raises ``DimensionError`` naming the failing node.

symbols.name: dimension_of
symbols.signature: (entity: Entity) -> Dimension
symbols.summary: The entity's dimension; dimensionless when none was declared (D6).

symbols.name: dimensionless
symbols.signature: () -> Dimension
symbols.usage: print("x / x is dimensionless:", (rate / rate) == dimensionless(), (rate / rate).is_dimensionless)

symbols.name: effective_sample_size
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike) -> float
symbols.summary: Bulk ESS via initial positive sequence of autocorrelations (Geyer 1992).

symbols.name: eti
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike, mass: float) -> Interval
symbols.summary: Equal-tailed interval: the ``(1-mass)/2`` and ``1-(1-mass)/2`` quantiles.

symbols.name: format_interval
symbols.signature: (lower: float, upper: float, *, uncertainty: float | None = None, digits: int = 2, fallback: int = 6, group: bool = False) -> str
symbols.summary: ``[lower, upper]`` with both bounds at the precision the width supports.
symbols.usage: print(format_interval(h.lower, h.upper), "from a half-width of", round(h.half_width, 4))

symbols.name: format_measured
symbols.signature: (value: float, uncertainty: float | None = None, *, digits: int = 2, fallback: int = 6, group: bool = False) -> str
symbols.summary: ``value`` as text, carrying only the digits ``uncertainty`` supports.

symbols.name: free_parameters
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec) -> tuple[Param, ...]
symbols.summary: Parameters that are inferred (everything not ``fixed``), in declaration order.

symbols.name: hdi
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike, mass: float) -> Interval
symbols.summary: Highest-density interval: the narrowest window containing ``mass`` of the draws.

symbols.name: interval
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike, *, definition: IntervalDefinition, mass: float) -> Interval

symbols.name: is_failure
symbols.signature: (x: object) -> TypeGuard[Failure]

symbols.name: jax_available
symbols.signature: () -> bool

symbols.name: latex
symbols.signature: (model: Model) -> str

symbols.name: latex_or_unsupported
symbols.signature: (model: Model) -> str | Unsupported
symbols.summary: ``latex``, unless the tree contains an ``Opaque`` node — then a typed refusal.

symbols.name: likelihood_scale
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, data: Mapping[str, ArrayLike], theta: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> Array
symbols.summary: The likelihood's scale at constrained values: the named parameter, or ``scale_expr`` evaluated on ``data`` and ``theta``. ``ValueError`` for a family without one.

symbols.name: load_spec
symbols.signature: (s: str) -> Spec
symbols.summary: Deserialize any spec from its envelope, resolving the class by name.

symbols.name: log_density
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, data: Mapping[str, ArrayLike], z: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> float
symbols.summary: Unnormalized log posterior in unconstrained coordinates: prior + Jacobian + likelihood.
symbols.usage: print("log prior:", round(log_prior(model, theta), 3), "| log density:", round(log_density(model, data, z), 3))

symbols.name: log_likelihood
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, data: Mapping[str, ArrayLike], theta: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> float
symbols.summary: Outcome log-likelihood at constrained values, plus every soft constraint's term.

symbols.name: log_prior
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, theta: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> float
symbols.summary: Sum of log prior densities of the free parameters at constrained values.
symbols.usage: print("log prior:", round(log_prior(model, theta), 3), "| log density:", round(log_density(model, data, z), 3))

symbols.name: mc_standard_error
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike) -> float
symbols.summary: Monte-Carlo SE of the mean, ``sd / sqrt(ESS)``.

symbols.name: missing_capabilities
symbols.signature: (producer: SupportsIntervention, required: frozenset[Capability] | set[Capability]) -> tuple[str, ...]
symbols.summary: Names of required capabilities the producer lacks, sorted; empty means go.

symbols.name: node_path
symbols.signature: (root: Model, target: Model) -> str

symbols.name: params
symbols.signature: (node: Model) -> tuple[Param, ...]
symbols.summary: Every distinct ``Param`` in the tree, by first appearance.
symbols.usage: print([p.name for p in params(model)], data_names(model))

symbols.name: require_jax
symbols.signature: () -> Unsupported | None

symbols.name: round_to
symbols.signature: (value: float, uncertainty: float, *, digits: int = 2) -> float
symbols.summary: ``value`` rounded to the place ``uncertainty`` reaches.

symbols.name: spec_type_name
symbols.signature: (cls: type[Spec]) -> str
symbols.summary: ``"<module>:<qualname>"`` — the name written into the envelope.

symbols.name: summarize
symbols.signature: (draws: ArrayLike, *, definition: IntervalDefinition = 'hdi', mass: float = 0.9) -> Summary

symbols.name: unconstrain
symbols.signature: (model: ModelSpec, theta: Mapping[str, ArrayLike]) -> dict[str, Array]
symbols.summary: Map constrained parameter values to R^k (log / logit per support).

symbols.name: value
symbols.signature: (model: Model, *, data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, opaque: OpaqueRegistry | None = None) -> Array
symbols.summary: Evaluate ``model`` numerically. Missing inputs raise ``KeyError`` naming the name.

symbols.name: wald
symbols.signature: (estimate: float, se: float, mass: float) -> Interval
symbols.summary: Frequentist ``estimate ± z_{(1+mass)/2} · se``, labelled as such.

symbols.name: walk
symbols.signature: (node: Model, path: str = '') -> Iterator[tuple[str, Model]]
symbols.summary: Pre-order traversal yielding ``(path, node)``; paths look like ``add[1].mul[0]``.

symbols.name: z_score
symbols.signature: (value: float, reference: float, reference_se: float) -> float
symbols.summary: ``(value - reference) / se``: how the statistical golden fixtures compare.
symbols.usage: print("z vs ref  :", z_score(value=ar.mean(), reference=0.0, reference_se=mc_standard_error(ar)))
